description: A way's one warning, the worst of the hazard kinds it crosses, in the words every app says it in (route_options' way `warning`; the route as typed, whose crossings come with its chips): a prohibited area or a TFR (14 CFR 91.133(a), 91.137 to 91.145), a restricted area (91.133(a), AIM 3-4-3), storms, high ground, a SIGMET, no fuel stop in reach, other weather, then a warning area, a MOA and an alert area (AIM 3-4-4 to 3-4-6) -- "Crosses a restricted area", "Crosses a MOA" ...; null where nothing is crossed.

kinds.description: The kinds of the hazards the way crosses (RouteOptionsHazard's kind).
